Inlined native Drawer: the web shared Drawer's createPortal + framer-motion slide-in + DOM focus trap / Escape / Tab cycling have no RN analog, so it becomes a <Modal animationType='slide' transparent visible={open} onRequestClose={onClose}> with a backdrop Pressable (tap -> onClose), a header (title + a \u2715 close Pressable, aria-label 'Close'), a ScrollView body (p-6 -> padding 24), and a bordered footer; the panel carries accessibilityViewIsModal + accessibilityLabel={title||'Panel'} (web role=dialog aria-modal aria-label). `side` ('right' default) anchors the panel via flexDirection row/row-reverse with the matching inner border (web border-l / border-r); max-w-md -> maxWidth 448. Modal keeps the component mounted while closed exactly like the web Drawer's `if(!open) return null` (FlagEditDrawer's hooks/state still run).

Inlined native Button: primary/secondary tones (accent / surfaceRaised, mirroring the existing FleetApiSection native admin Button) with an ActivityIndicator while loading (web animated SVG spinner) and accessibilityState {disabled,busy}; disabled||loading both block onPress (web disabled={disabled||loading} + aria-busy). Inlined native Textarea: multiline <TextInput> (web <textarea>) with a label row (visible rose `*` + required folded into accessibilityLabel since RN has no label/for), rows -> numberOfLines + minHeight, a focus accent border (web focus:border-cyan-500), an error border (web border-red-500/50) + an error caption (web text-red-400); radius 6 matches the sibling native Input/Textarea ports.

No DOM elements, framer-motion, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, react-dom, or web UI-kit modules are imported into the native output — only React, RN primitives (Modal/Pressable/ScrollView/TextInput/View/ActivityIndicator/StyleSheet), the already-ported native Input, the shared apps/native AppText + GlassPanel, and theme tokens (colors/spacing). Verified with `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint -- --quiet`, and `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` (added __tests__/FlagEditDrawer.test.tsx covering create vs edit title, the key field disabled+immutable note in edit mode, the JSON parse-error -> Save disabled + error surfaced, empty-value/empty-reason gating, the happy-path onSave payload {key,value,reason} with trimming, Cancel -> onClose, and saving -> loading/disabled).
